gaps.sentence: Their son grew ___ and moved abroad.
The ink ___ off after the first wash.
gaps.explanation: 'Come off' = become removed, especially by washing.

gaps.sentence: Put ___ your toys when you've finished playing.
gaps.explanation: put away = put something in its usual place.

gaps.sentence: The evidence finally backed ___ his version of events.
gaps.explanation: back up = support with evidence (a claim backs up a story).

gaps.sentence: I came ___ an old letter while clearing the attic.
Please carry ___ with your work; don't mind me.
gaps.explanation: carry on = continue; carry out = perform (a task).

gaps.sentence: During the tour she pointed ___ the oldest house in town.
gaps.explanation: point out = mention/draw attention to a fact.

gaps.sentence: We've decided to do ___ a holiday this year.
gaps.explanation: do without = manage without having something.
